subject.title: Feature: channels.slack.ignoreSubtypes config key to suppress message_changed / message_deleted events

question: Should Slack edit/delete subtype events get a new public `channels.slack.ignoreSubtypes` opt-in config key, become dropped by default, or remain system events?
rationale: The current behavior is intentional and shipped, while the requested fix adds a new public Slack config surface that repository policy treats as product and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Approve narrow opt-in config
options.body: Add `ignoreSubtypes` for `message_changed` and `message_deleted` only, with schema/docs/tests and no default behavior change.

options.title: Change the default policy
options.body: Drop edit/delete subtype system events by default, accepting a behavior change for users who rely on those system events.

options.title: Decline the config surface
options.body: Keep edit/delete subtype events as system events and document prompt or agent policy as the supported workaround.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow opt-in config
recommendation.body: Add `ignoreSubtypes` for `message_changed` and `message_deleted` only, with schema/docs/tests and no default behavior change.
